frequency_question: How often do major announced central industrial financing schemes reach formal final notification within their target timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes major national-level electric mobility, capital goods, or manufacturing incentive/financing schemes formally proposed by the Union Ministry of Heavy Industries and carried through to final notification. Excludes minor guideline revisions or unrelated ministries.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell Battery
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named major schemes; perfectly capturing the subset of primary ministry-led heavy industry incentive policies.
known_gaps: Does not account for minor sub-schemes that may have been quietly shelved before public draft stages.
skeleton: Ministry major scheme delivery rate across distinct policy iterations within recent electoral/administrative terms.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 documented major initiatives
validity_reason: Tied to the stability of administrative priorities within the current central governance framework, remaining stable for several years.
